===Catacomb of Famine (level 2)===
[[File:Ricketty door chathead.png|left|link=Rickety door]]
The second level is occupied by level 26 [[giant rat]]s, level 30/44/53 [[Zombie (Stronghold of Security)|zombies]], and level 28/35/41 [[flesh crawler]]s, which drop the [[bottom of sceptre]] for the [[skull sceptre]]. Killing flesh crawlers is a popular member's money making method for low levels due to frequent valuable herb drops. The last room contains the [[Grain of Plenty]], which rewards the player with 3,000 coins and the "Slap Head" emote. <br>
The portal to the end of this floor can be used at a combat level of 51 or above, even if the reward hasn't been claimed before.
